blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — A pre-dawn operation to capture Northern Mindanao’s most wanted fugitive ended in a bloody firefight last Friday, Nov. 13, leaving the suspect and a police intelligence officer dead in Lanao del Norte province. A police patrolman was also wounded during the 5:30 a.m. shootout, which erupted when a joint police and military task force cornered Mugot Binasing Pintal, alias “Palos,” at the boundary of Nunungan and Sapad towns. Pintal, ranked as the top fugitive by the Northern Mindanao Police Regional Office (PRO 10), had been dodging seven arrest warrants issued by Regional Trial Court Branch […]...
